original_value: Big data is employed in widely different fields; we here study how education uses big data. We review the literature of the research about big data in education in the time interval from 2010 to 2020 then review the process of big educational data mining, the tools, and the applications of big data in education. This paper, with the help of these applications, explores the idea to improve the education process. Two methods are applied to validate education process and many parameters are discussed to complete the research.

result.paraphrase: Big data is used across many different fields; here we examine its use in education. We survey the research literature on big data in education from 2010 to 2020, then examine the process of big educational data mining, the tools, and the applications of big data in education. Using these applications, this paper explores the idea of improving the education process. Two methods are applied to validate the education process, and many parameters are discussed to complete the research.
